title: Assertion
description: A typed claim, the period it is claimed to hold, when SSoR recorded it, and its origin. An assertion is authoritative for what was claimed and why it was believed — not for the world.

subject.description: What the claim is about: an entity or matter, e.g. 'matter:M-1042'.

object.description: The claimed value. Structured where the predicate defines a shape (e.g. status is an enum defined by the tenant's matter model).

matter.description: Matter context, when the claim concerns one.

authority.description: The designated authority the origin was evaluated against (authority map entry), as of record time.

derivation.description: Id of the derivation record: where this claim came from. No claim without lineage (B-13, principle 4).

supersedes.description: Present on a correction: the claims this one replaces (B-18). Superseded claims stay in the record, marked. A resolution supersedes nothing (B-19).

supersededBy.description: Set when a later correction supersedes this claim. Server-set; never in a payload.

confidence.description: Metadata only: a model-reported confidence never changes origin and is not a calibrated probability (README §Origin rules).
